name: eclipse -story of summer menace-
source:
It's a kind of story that begins with the brutal heat of summer.
It takes place in Sento, a lively local city where old-school streets with hot spring steam mix with modern buildings.
Old and new blended together under a blanket of calm.
However, disquieting rumors were beginning to spread through that peaceful city.
They claimed, "You can meet someone who's died."
They said, "You can see someone who's nowhere to be found."
Meanwhile, our main character Natsuki Sakatsuki was finally enjoying some "boring days" and throwing herself into her hobby (girl-watching).
Her mom had died last year, leaving her with a mysterious power and giving no explanation.
That power slowly ate away at her normal life until it flung open the door to something unreal.
So for once she felt relieved by these boring days that came around so rarely.
Fate, however, wasn't about to let that last; right before summer break on the day before closing ceremony a student's suicide shattered those boring days, and set off a chain of events leading toward an inevitable ending...

[Translated from [url=http://blog.livedoor.jp/muko650/archives/51739923.html]muko650[/url]]
translation:
这是一个从酷暑开始的故事。
故事发生在仙洞，一座充满活力的当地城市，古老的街道与温泉蒸汽与现代建筑融为一体。
新旧在平静的毯子下融合在一起。
然而，令人不安的谣言开始在这座平静的城市传播。
他们声称，“你可以见到已经去世的人。”
他们说：“你可以看到一个无处可寻的人。”
与此同时，我们的主角坂月夏希终于享受了一些“无聊的日子”，并投入到她的爱好（看女孩）中。
她的母亲去年去世了，给她留下了一种神秘的力量，但没有给出任何解释。
这种力量慢慢地侵蚀着她的正常生活，直到它猛然打开了通向某种不真实事物的大门。
这一次，她对这些难得一见的无聊日子感到释然。
然而，命运并没有让这种情况持续下去。暑假前夕，结业典礼前一天，一名学生的自杀事件打破了那些无聊的日子，并引发了一系列事件，最终走向了不可避免的结局……

[翻译自[url=http://blog.livedoor.jp/muko650/archives/51739923.html]muko650[/url]]
